'''Zhensanovian Scripts''' are the writing systems associated with the [[Zhensanovian Languages]].

The extracted source names several traditional systems: a runic script for [[Murianic Languages]], a syllabic script for [[Agashkinic Languages]], a modified Cyrillic-derived alphabet for [[Tekdolian Languages]], and a historical pictographic system for [[Toramdic Languages]]. Other regional systems remain possible but are not yet reviewed.

== Standardization ==

The [[Union Alphabet]] is the modern standardized writing system in the source set. It was developed to represent sounds across the Zhensanovian language family without openly privileging one regional language branch over the others.
